name: Example table: park area in shade
description: The share of a park's area in shade at noon, for an open lawn design and a tree canopy design. One of nine example tables that illustrate ways to chart a comparison of scenarios, each row's scenario in its case column. The Nine ways to chart scenario comparisons test dataflow draws it as a donut per design. Curio's seeded script scripts/build_example_scenario_charts.py writes it.
